GOOD TO KNOW

Email tickets work differently from this release. A new email about something else now gets its own ticket and number, even when the same customer has a ticket open or one that was just resolved. A reply still goes back to its ticket. This applies to every email account, also those that do not open tickets: a second email with a different subject is its own conversation.

SMS, WhatsApp and web chat are unchanged: a message there still reopens the customer's last resolved ticket within seven days.

Nothing already saved in an automatic reply is changed. Where two placeholders touch, the form warns and offers to add the space.

FOR AGENTS

Consult a colleague: their desk now rings, flashes its title and notifies, and says who is calling and about whom, with Answer and Decline. You see who is ringing and the seconds left, then "did not answer", "declined" or "not signed in to the phone", with Try again. The picker shows each colleague's state before you choose.

Tickets on the desk: the Tickets panel lists all the customer's tickets, with the one for the conversation you are in first.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

A ticket for each new email: a reply to one of a ticket's emails, an email that quotes the ticket's number, or "Re:" with the same subject goes back to that ticket and reopens it within seven days. Anything else from the same sender opens a new ticket with a new number. Each ticket's emails carry its own number, so a customer can have several open at once.

Why was no reply sent?: each incoming email keeps the automatic reply it got, or the reason it got none, shown on the email account. A rule that goes by opening hours warns when the account has no opening hours (it is then never closed, so an out-of-hours reply is never sent). "Send a test" sends a rule to your own address.

Placeholders in automatic replies: Insert now puts a space between a placeholder and its neighbours, and the form warns when two touch ("CASE-000042Invoice query") with an Add a space button. A Placeholders button beside Insert opens the full reference: what to type, what it becomes, an example, whether it works in the subject, the message or both, and what happens when the value is missing. The same table is in Help under WhatsApp, SMS and email.

Pictures in Help: every guide now shows a screenshot of the page it describes, in Help, the ? panel, the agent desk, Academy lessons and the training articles. The pictures are of a made-up sample organisation."}
